refund.text: Refunds follow the policy displayed on the event page. Review the Refund Policy and your event's terms. If you need a decision or help with a charge, send Operations a request below; submitting does not guarantee a refund.

report.text: You can report an event or organizer directly to Function Hour Operations. Include the event link and what happened; please avoid sharing passwords, authentication codes, or payment details.

merch.text: Open My Merch Orders to check an order's fulfillment status. If you cannot find it or need help with delivery, send Operations a request below.

payment.text: For a payment or duplicate charge, check My Orders and send Operations a request with the event name and purchase email. Never provide your full card number or sign-in code.

ticket.text: Sign in with the email used at checkout, then open My Tickets or My Orders. If a paid order is missing, send Operations the event name and purchase email below. Do not send your QR code or full card number.

account.text: Sign in using your purchase email. If you still cannot reach your account, send Operations a request below without sharing your password or a verification code.

discovery.text: The Events directory and Map show current Function Hour listings. Open an event for its latest details, tickets, venue, and organizer policy.

general.text: I can point you to Function Hour pages or help you contact Operations. Choose a topic below, or send a support request if the site does not answer your question.
